kitDescription: Privaty: Unkind Maid is an Electric shotgun Attacker whose kit revolves around pellet counters. Every 30 pellets she lands, she fires a bonus hit of 202.84% of her final ATK at the enemies nearest her crosshair. Whenever she lands at least 5 pellets with a single shot, she gains a short 2-second reload-speed buff, which on her slow 9-shell shotgun translates directly into more shots per fight. During Full Burst, every 30 pellet hits also drip one shell back into her magazine and stack a 2-second ATK buff up to 5 times. Her Burst III gives her 10 seconds of increased attack damage and a large critical damage boost, and deals a single 1066.66% burst hit to all enemies.

skill1.explanation: Driver test pins repeated firing at 202.84 in the skill bucket and discriminates the per-pull counterfactual (count:10 fires ≥3× as often). Fired-vs-landed pellet cadence is a documented ⚑1 (near-equivalent at ~9/10 focus-band landing), not a silent drop.

verdictRationale: Convergence is mechanical and clean: the blind S5 suite runs 24 passed / 3 legit-GAP skips / 0 failed against the shipped override, and the S6 blind override is structurally identical to the driver's on all five load-bearing lines — including the one genuine process catch, where the S2b reviewer surfaced fbGate:'inFb' for skill2b and the driver verified the primitive and corrected an initial UNMODELED draft. No REAL-GOTCHA survives: the three known approximations (fired-vs-landed pellet cadence ⚑1, the dropped ≥5-pellet gate ⚑2, the ungated counter accrual ⚑3) are all documented in the override note with tiers and recipes, and the priority misreads the review predicted — pellets-vs-rounds, full-magazine refill, fullBurstEnter keying, allies-scoping, FB major on the nuke — are each pinned by a discriminating counterfactual or a direct event assertion. The residual the owner should spot-check: neither test suite builds the named fullBurstEnter counterfactual for the burst self-buffs, so that nearest-wrong model is unpinned in isolation; it is behaviorally vacuous in the sole-B3 driver fixture (her cast precedes every Full Burst), but in any future dual-B3 graded comp the distinction becomes live and a one-line counterfactual should be added. Separately, all agents are the same model family, so the fired-vs-landed pellet cadence (⚑1) and the SG cadence tuple (⚑4, mandatory per the driver's own note) remain measurement-gated items a real focus video would settle — they are flagged, not silently absorbed.
